;Business and economy
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[G20]] finance ministers said they will present an action plan to address the debt vulnerabilities, as well as delivering financial aid to emerging economies. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-g20-idUSKBN21I1ZZ (Reuters)]
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on aviation]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates]]
***[[Crown Prince of Dubai|Dubai Crown Prince]] [[Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum|Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum]] says that [[Dubai]] will provide financial assistance to [[Emirates (airline)|Emirates Airlines]]. [https://www.ft.com/content/352974af-77bf-407d-93fd-afe449c7d0cc (''Financial Times'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*Eighteen [[firefighter]]s and their guide are killed by a [[forest fire]] in [[Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture|Liangshan]], [[Sichuan]], [[China]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-52103106 (BBC News)]
*[[2020 Central Idaho earthquake]]
**A 6.5 magnitude [[earthquake]] happens {{convert|72|km|mi|abbr=on}} west of [[Challis, Idaho]], United States. It is the strongest earthquake in the state since [[1983 Borah Peak earthquake|1983]]. [https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/us70008jr5/executive (USGS)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***The [[government of the Solomon Islands]] orders all schools closed to combat [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/413013/all-schools-ordered-to-close-in-solomon-islands (RNZ)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
****[[China]] reports 48 imported cases of COVID-19. [https://apnews.com/1fd6413c9615da74d44d971075ebf4ff (AP News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Myanmar]]
****[[Myanmar]] reports the country's first death from COVID-19 as confirmed cases rise to 14. The patient was a 69-year-old man with [[cancer]] in [[Yangon]]. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/1890140/myanmar-reports-first-coronavirus-death-as-case-numbers-rise (''The Bangkok Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belgium]]
****A 12-year-old girl dies from COVID-19 in [[Belgium]], becoming Europe's youngest victim to date. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-belgium-death/belgian-girl-becomes-europes-youngest-coronavirus-victim-media-idUSKBN21I1W8 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[Department of Health and Social Care]] reports 393 more deaths from [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the country's death toll to 1,789 and 25,150 cases. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/coronavirus-uk-deaths-england-uk-cases-update-today-a9438366.html (''The Independent'')]
****A 13-year-old boy dies at the [[King's College Hospital]], becoming the [[United Kingdom|UK]]'s youngest victim from the virus to date. [https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-healthy-boy-13-is-youngest-uk-victim-11966526 (Sky News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)|COVID-19 pandemic in New York]]
*****The total number of cases in [[New York (state)|New York]] rises to over 75,000. The state's death toll reaches 1,550. [https://nypost.com/2020/03/31/new-york-state-coronavirus-cases-top-75000-death-toll-reaches-1550/ (''New York Post'')]
*****[[United States House of Representatives|Rep.]] [[Max Rose]] is expected to be deployed with the [[United States National Guard|National Guard]] to New York as an effort to contain the coronavirus. [https://www.politico.com/amp/news/2020/03/31/max-rose-deployed-national-guard-157150 (''Politico'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Guam]]
*****[[United States Navy]] Captain [[Brett Crozier]] requests urgent help from [[The Pentagon]] following an outbreak of COVID-19 aboard the [[USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71)|USS ''Theodore Roosevelt'']] [[aircraft carrier]], which is currently docked in [[Guam]]. Crozier has recommended quarantining almost the entire crew of 4,000. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-52110298 (BBC News)]
****The [[United States]] surpasses China in the number of deaths linked to COVID-19, as the death toll rises to 3,416, according to [[Johns Hopkins University]]. [https://www.thedenverchannel.com/news/national/coronavirus/us-passes-china-in-number-of-covid-19-deaths-more-people-have-now-died-of-disease-than-died-in-9-11 (The Denver Channel)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in El Salvador]]
****[[El Salvador]]'s [[President of El Salvador|President]] [[Nayib Bukele]] confirms the country's first death from COVID-19. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-el-salvador/el-salvador-registers-countrys-first-coronavirus-death-idUKKBN21I3MM?il=0 (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Burundi]]
****[[Burundi]] reports the country's first cases of COVID-19. The patients are two Burundians, aged 56 and 42, who recently returned from the [[United Arab Emirates]] and neighbouring [[Rwanda]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/burundi-confirms-first-2-covid-19-cases/1787083 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sierra Leone]]
****In a televised address, [[Sierra Leone]]'s President [[Julius Maada Bio]] confirms the country's first case of COVID-19, a 37-year-old man who had recently travelled back from [[France]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-leone/sierra-leone-has-confirmed-its-first-case-of-coronavirus-president-says-idUSKBN21I1MY (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Senegal]]
****Former President of  French [[association football]] club [[Olympique de Marseille]], [[Pape Diouf]], dies from COVID-19 in [[Senegal]], becoming the country's first fatality from the virus. [https://www.theguardian.com/football/2020/mar/31/former-marseille-president-pape-diouf-dies-of-coronavirus (''The Guardian'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa]]
****Prominent scientist and [[HIV/AIDS]] researcher [[Gita Ramjee]] dies from COVID-19 in [[Umhlanga, KwaZulu-Natal]], [[South Africa]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-52120265 (BBC News)]

;International relations
*[[United States–Venezuela relations]], [[Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**In a policy shift, the [[United States]] proposes a "Democratic Transition Framework" which includes that both disputed Presidents, [[Nicolás Maduro]] and [[Juan Guaidó]], step aside from the office. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics-usa-exclusive/in-policy-shift-u-s-offers-to-lift-venezuela-sanctions-in-power-sharing-deal-idUSKBN21I147 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime 
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkmenistan]]
***[[Turkmenistan]]'s government bans the usage of the word "coronavirus" in all public settings and also bans the use of face masks. The government maintains there are no cases in the country. [https://www.npr.org/sections/coronavirus-live-updates/2020/03/31/824611607/turkmenistan-has-banned-use-of-the-word-coronavirus (NPR)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Wisconsin]]
****The [[2020 Wisconsin Democratic primary|Wisconsin primary]] is expected to go as planned for April 7 despite coronavirus concerns. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/31/politics/wisconsin-primary-coronavirus/index.html (CNN)]
*Former [[Vice President of Syria|Syrian Vice President]] [[Abdul Halim Khaddam]] dies of a heart attack in [[Paris]], [[France]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-syria-khaddam/ex-syrian-vice-president-khaddam-dies-in-france-source-close-to-him-idUKKBN21I1A4 (Reuters)]

;Science and technology
*The [[World Meteorological Organization]] will not retire any names from the [[2019 Atlantic hurricane season]] this year due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]]. Instead, retired names from that season, as well as the upcoming 2020 season, will be announced jointly during next year's annual spring meeting. [https://weather.com/safety/hurricane/news/2020-03-30-retired-atlantic-hurricane-names-2019-dorian (Weather)]

***The [[Chinese Basketball Association]] delays the restart of its season due to the coronavirus pandemic. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/Sports/china-delays-restart-basketball-events/story?id=69894185 (ABC News)]
